question:
Unpolarized light of intensity $I_0$ is incident normally on a stack of three ideal polaroids $P_1, P_2, P_3$ placed successively.

The transmission axis of $P_1$ is fixed. The axis of $P_2$ makes an angle $30^{\circ}$ with the axis of $P_1$, and the axis of $P_3$ makes an angle $90^{\circ}$ with the axis of $P_1$.

(i) Find the intensity $I$ emerging from $P_3$ in terms of $I_0$.

(ii) Now suppose $P_2$ is removed. Find the new transmitted intensity $I'$ and compute the ratio $\dfrac{I}{I'}$.
